title: i18n wiring: English catalogue complete for the shell, navigation, auth and shared components; language switch
goal: Make the app's interface text come from translation files, starting with the parts every user sees, so other languages can be added.
why: A custom i18n context exists (desktop/src/lib/i18n.ts, components/providers/i18n-provider.tsx, messages/en.json 343 keys, hi, ar 53 keys) but 0 of 193 pages use it; settings.language is a stub.
steps: i18n.ts: t(key, vars) with interpolation and plural (one/other) support, fallback to English then to the key; locale from the user setting (users.locale from R202 if merged, else localStorage) with a switch in Settings > Profile (en, hi, ar).

Move all literals in the shell (sidebar, top bar, nav titles in nav-config.ts, page header defaults), the four auth pages and shared components under components/ui that show text (empty states, confirm dialogs, pagination, filter bar labels) to en.json with namespaced keys (nav.leads, auth.login.title, ...).
scripts/i18n-check.mjs: fails when a key used in code is missing from en.json, and reports hi/ar coverage percentage.

ESLint: add a warn-level rule against JSX string literals in the files converted (eslint-plugin-react has jsx-no-literals; use it only if already installed, else a no-restricted-syntax selector for JSXText with letters) scoped to the converted folders, so lint-gate does not rise elsewhere.
tests: auth-shell and dashboard specs still pass (English text unchanged).
acceptance: Shell, auth and shared components have no hardcoded English (grep in those files).
Switching to Hindi changes the shell text.
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts e2e/dashboard.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, FilterBar + infinite scroll, RelationCombobox, PhoneInput, useConfirm, graceful degradation). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.
English strings must stay byte-identical so existing e2e selectors by text keep working.
No machine translation calls (cost rule). Hindi keys you add may be left untranslated (fallback to English).
